description: Live in-play sport matches happening right now, with running score and match clock. Pass a sport_id (1=Soccer, 18=Basketball, 13=Tennis, 16=Baseball, 17=Ice Hockey, 12=American Football, 91=Volleyball, 78=Handball, 3=Cricket, 14=Snooker, 92=Table Tennis, 15=Darts, 9=Boxing/MMA). Example: betsapi_inplay({ sport_id: "1", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: BetsAPI key (get one at betsapi.com, from ~$10/mo)

sport_id.description: BetsAPI sport id. Common: 1=Soccer, 18=Basketball, 13=Tennis, 16=Baseball, 17=Ice Hockey, 12=American Football, 91=Volleyball, 78=Handball, 3=Cricket, 14=Snooker, 92=Table Tennis, 15=Darts, 9=Boxing/MMA
